items.title: Government Technology and Contracting
items.description: DC's government technology ecosystem — the contractors and technology companies building software and AI for federal agencies — has specific AI requirements shaped by government procurement, security clearance constraints, FedRAMP, and NIST frameworks. ClickMasters builds commercial AI for government-adjacent organizations with awareness of federal technology standards, though ClickMasters is not a cleared contractor and government classified work is outside scope. AI applications: document intelligence for federal procurement, NLP for regulatory compliance monitoring, predictive analytics for policy outcome modeling, and knowledge management AI for government-adjacent organizations.

items.title: Policy, Research, and Think Tanks
